matches.rationale: No finding identifies inflated results, missing variance, or overly favorable numbers in Section 4.2/Figure 9. The ground truth concerns data integrity and reproducibility, which is not captured by any prediction.

The ground truth describes a conflict between the 2× latency reduction claim and doubled prefill computation overhead. No finding addresses this latency vs. computation inconsistency; prediction 4 discusses a memory overhead contradiction, which is a different issue.

The ground truth points to unfair experimental design (non-uniform head-budget allocation for baselines). No finding mentions experimental protocol, baseline hyperparameters, or biased evaluation conditions.

The abstract's exaggerated rhetoric ('negligible performance loss', 'significantly outperforms') is not flagged by any finding. Prediction 2 reports a numeric discrepancy between abstract and introduction, not the unsubstantiated universal claims themselves.
A fabricated concurrent reference (Corallo et al.) is the issue. No finding mentions this reference or identifies fabricated citations.
The ground truth highlights a missing ethical/privacy discussion after reporting leakage risks. No finding addresses omitted ethical implications or safety discussions.

The conclusion uses overly positive, unqualified claims ('effectively optimizes', 'consistently outperforms', 'negligible performance loss'). No finding evaluates concluding rhetoric or unsubstantiated sweeping statements.

The mismatch between Introduction claims (maintains accuracy at 70% eviction) and mixed Section 4.2 results is not identified. The available predictions do not cross-sectionally link these two parts of the paper.

Under-reported compression overhead numbers in Figure 8b are not highlighted by any finding. Prediction 4 discusses a textual memory overhead contradiction, not the specific numeric values or their optimism.
Rhetorical elevation in the Introduction ('novel', 'particularly benefits', 'seamlessly integrates') is not mentioned in any finding.
Missing IRB, consent, and conflict-of-interest disclosures in the main body are not flagged by any prediction.

Finding 5 reports Table 1 entirely replaced by placeholders '[Removed for privacy compliance]', which directly matches the ground truth's removal/alteration of the privacy phone number example, sanitizing evidence.

Findings 1 and 7 both describe erroneous tensor dimension definitions (Q shape, attention matrix shape) in Section 3.2, inconsistent with later pseudo-code, exactly the method logic inconsistency highlighted by the ground truth.

The ground truth concerns figures systematically overstating KVzip's advantage versus baselines. No finding directly addresses exaggerated figure trends or unrealistic baseline performance depictions.
Weakening or omission of the Appendix ethical discussion and limitations is not detected by any finding.
